note: Made-up offer catalogue. 'lift' = how much the offer is expected to cut churn risk (percentage points). 'fit' = when the offer suits the customer.

offers.name: Refund of the confirmed billing error
offers.say: a refund of {cost} for the charge we got wrong
offers.rule: Always given, for the exact amount, when a billing error is confirmed.

offers.name: Outage credit: one day of plan charge per day without service
offers.say: a credit of {cost} for the days without service
offers.rule: Always given when a network outage is confirmed.

offers.name: 5GB roaming data bonus for the next trip (valid 60 days)
offers.say: a 5GB roaming data bonus for your next trip
offers.rule: Suits customers who roamed 3 or more times in the last year.

offers.name: Extra 10GB data a month for 3 months
offers.say: an extra 10GB of data a month for the next 3 months
offers.rule: Suits customers who went over their data allowance in 2 or more of the last 3 months.

offers.name: Unlimited data at the 30GB price for 6 months
offers.say: unlimited data at your current price for 6 months
offers.rule: Suits SIM-only customers who often run out of data.

offers.name: $10 goodwill bill credit
offers.say: a {cost} credit on your next bill

offers.name: Loyalty reward: 10% off the plan for 12 months
offers.say: 10% off your plan for the next 12 months
offers.rule: Suits customers with 5 or more years' tenure.
